title: Persistent decoded-course cache on the web build
summary: The web build now keeps decoded terrain, sky and sound data plus uncompressed course and rider archives in Cache Storage (atv-decoded-v1), so repeat visits to a course skip most of the decode work. The venue also no longer builds its heightfield twice (PR #505, closes #452).
details: Entries are keyed by the content manifest hash and a format version, validated on read, and capped at 192 MiB. Any storage failure falls back to the normal load path. Desktop is unaffected. Measured on a desktop host, not a phone: ENV01 warm load 1.34-1.38 s to 0.79-0.83 s (-40%); at 4x CPU throttle 4.0 s to 2.95 s (-26%); the first cold load is about 0.2 s slower because it writes the cache.
limitation: No physical-phone measurement. Not cached: sky mip chains, scene text parsing, main-thread model texture and mesh conversion, shader compiles. One ENV01 visit stores about 63 MB.
